summary: Authors flashcard decks, matching games, and memory card games — interactive items driven by a list of two-sided fact pairs with optional LaTeX math.
in_scope: Flashcard study decks (front / back fact pairs)
Matching games where players pair related terms
Memory card games where players flip hidden cards to find pairs
out_of_scope: Scored assessments (rubrics, answer keys, graded items) — use L0158
Spaced repetition scheduling or retention tracking
Dynamic deck generation — facts are literal in the program
Freeform diagrams or boards — use L0172
Games other than flashcards / match / memory (trivia, MCQ, word searches, crosswords)
Card ordering or shuffling policies — left to the renderer
